title: Nudge policy (b): the far-apart threshold against kill latency. T4's roster on the shipped v5.6 (ecology on, coupling on, packs of five), three thresholds for 'kept apart': 20, 40 (shipped) and 80 tiles, each after 3,000 ticks, radius 6. Forty-five thousand ticks, two replicates each. Measured: ticks from the first armed pack's arrival to the first armed kill, nudges performed, and how the pack's track looks.
fork: v5.6 default for far_tiles: is 40 right, or does 20 kill sooner without looking teleported, or does 80 kill at all.

predictions.expects: latency falls with the threshold; 20 kills soonest with the most nudges
20 and 40 kill within a few thousand ticks of each other; 80 sometimes never
latency and nudge counts do not order by threshold

kill_criterion: the largest threshold that still kills in 2 of 2 within the budget is the default; ties go to the larger (fewer teleports)
culling: drop a replicate on any breach or changed save

arms.name: far20
pre: local sw=reqscript('seasonal-wildlife'); local cfg=sw.loadConfig(); if not cfg.initialized then sw.captureDefault(cfg) end; local pool=sw.buildPool(cfg); local n=0; for _,e in ipairs(pool) do if e.inEmbark and sw.defaultAllow(e) then cfg.allow[e.key]=true; n=n+1 end end; local a,f=sw.assignFromMatrix(cfg,pool); for _,t in ipairs({'COUGAR','DINGO','WOLF','BIRD_EMU','BADGER','WOMBAT','PORCUPINE','KANGAROO','GROUNDHOG','SKUNK'}) do cfg.assign[t]={0,1,2,3}; cfg.allow[t]=true end; cfg.groups.enabled=true; cfg.groups.coupling=true; cfg.groups.pack=5; cfg.ecology.enabled=true; sw.saveConfig(cfg); local act=sw.applyLive(cfg, df.global.cur_season); sw.saveConfig(cfg); sw.enableSched(); print(('roster: allowed %d assigned %d thin %d applied %d; predators and prey in every season; groups on, coupling on, pack 5, ecology %s; rotation enabled'):format(n,a,f,act, tostring(true)))
